sse.go parseSSE parameter type is interface{Read([]byte)(int,error)} instead of io.Reader

architect/llm_client.go: LLM API error responses include raw body in error messages — potential secret leak if API echoes headers
architect/llm_client.go scrubSecretsJSON only handles JSON-string contexts — misses secrets in plain text or binary

architect/llm_client.go: double retry — LLMAdapter retries 3x and llmclient.Client also retries internally; 9x amplification
architect/llm_client.go CircuitBreaker has no half-open state — recovery requires full SuccessThreshold consecutive successes
harness.go: RestoreHarness runID derived from len(turnRecords) — fragile if records are deleted

summary: F108 Architecture Normalization reviewed (Round 3, inline-contents). All code compiles, all tests pass. Reviewed: llmclient (156 LOC unified HTTP client), sse.go (163 LOC SSE parser with tool_call accumulation), livegw (134 LOC ModelGateway), architect/llm_client.go (222 LOC with retry+CB+secret scrubbing), harness.go (393 LOC FSM with ErrHarnessTerminated sentinel), bridge_serve.go (381 LOC ServeBridge), discovery/llm.go (32 LOC type aliases), strataudit/llmclient.go (300 LOC with cache+rate limit). All 7 roles: PASS. Finding distribution: 0x P0, 0x P1, 10x P2, 5x P3. Top themes: (1) retry amplification across layers (architect + strataudit both retry on top of llmclient), (2) inconsistent resilience posture (discovery and strataudit lack circuit breakers that architect has), (3) pre-existing security regex gap for OpenRouter key format. Verdict: APPROVED.
